events.title: OpenAI limits GPT-6 Cyber to approved Daybreak Red users
events.title_zh: OpenAI 将 GPT-6 Cyber 首批开放给获批 Daybreak Red 用户
events.summary_en: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber for vulnerability discovery and exploit validation. Initial access is limited to a select group of approved Daybreak Red customers through the API and Codex. OpenAI reports 48.5% on ExploitGym and large gains in scope adherence, plus Linux and Firefox findings; these results come from OpenAI and named partners rather than an independent benchmark release.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Cyber，用于漏洞发现与 exploit 验证。首批仅向获批 Daybreak Red 客户开放，可通过 API 与 Codex 使用。OpenAI 报告其 ExploitGym 为 48.5%，并称边界遵循明显提升，还披露了 Linux 与 Firefox 发现；这些结果来自 OpenAI 与具名合作方，不是独立 benchmark 发布。
events.why_it_matters_en: For security teams, the model raises the ceiling for automated exploit research, but restricted access, private safety processing, IP allowlisting and human oversight make it a controlled program rather than a generally available API.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对安全团队来说，它抬高了自动化 exploit 研究上限；但受限准入、Private Safety Processing、IP allowlist 与人工监督意味着它是受控计划，不是通用 GA API。

technical_details.controls: IP allowlisting by default for Daybreak Red API; misuse monitoring; PSP generally required with ZDR

events.next_action_en: Wait for broader Daybreak Red access and independent reproduction, then assess exploit quality, scope violations, data handling and review.

events.title: NVIDIA releases four Cosmos 3 checkpoints for interactive simulation
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 发布四个 Cosmos 3 交互仿真 checkpoint
events.summary_en: NVIDIA released four open-weight Cosmos 3 Nano post-training checkpoints for driving and robotics simulation. The 16B-parameter variants cover multi-view camera and LiDAR generation, simulator-to-video transfer and action-conditioned bimanual video prediction. Checkpoints and a technical report are public under OpenMDW 1.1; suitability for policy learning remains unproven.
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 发布四个开放权重 Cosmos 3 Nano 后训练 checkpoint，面向驾驶与机器人仿真。16B 变体覆盖多视角相机与 LiDAR 生成、模拟器到视频迁移，以及按动作预测双臂机器人视频。checkpoint 与技术报告已公开，采用 OpenMDW 1.1；是否适合训练真实策略仍未证实。
events.why_it_matters_en: For robotics teams, public action-conditioned and multi-sensor world models lower the cost of simulation experiments, but generated realism is not evidence that a learned policy will transfer safely to real hardware.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对机器人团队来说，公开的动作条件与多传感器 world model 降低了仿真实验门槛；生成画面逼真不等于策略能安全迁移到真实硬件。

events.title: Microsoft tests formal proofs for agent-written full-stack code
events.title_zh: Microsoft 用形式化证明检查 agent 编写的全栈代码
events.summary_en: Microsoft Research described PDD Kit, a workflow that turns approved intent into a Verus specification, proves generated Rust code against it and uses tests for trusted components outside the proof. The reported case covers login logic in one roughly 5,000-line full-stack application. Microsoft explicitly lists six trusted pieces and says a wrong specification can still verify the wrong behavior; no standalone PDD Kit release was verified.
events.summary_zh: Microsoft Research 介绍 PDD Kit：把人批准的意图转成 Verus specification，证明生成的 Rust 代码满足它，再用测试覆盖 proof 之外的可信组件。案例只覆盖一个约 5,000 行全栈应用的登录逻辑。Microsoft 明确列出六个可信边界，也承认错误 specification 仍会证明出错误行为；本轮未核实到独立的 PDD Kit 发布。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams reviewing large agent-generated changes, proofs could shift review from every generated line toward explicit intent. The evidence is still one narrow Rust case, so it is a research direction, not a production replacement for code review.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对审查大规模 agent 代码的团队来说，proof 可能把重点从逐行阅读转向明确意图。现有证据仍是单个 Rust 案例，不能替代生产代码审查。

technical_details.method: plain-language intent -> Verus spec -> proof for covered Rust code -> tests for trusted boundary
technical_details.case_study: Pet Store login logic in an approximately 5,000-line Rust full-stack app
technical_details.trusted_boundary: six pieces; password check and two database lookups carry most weight
technical_details.availability: research description; no standalone PDD Kit artifact verified

technical_details_zh.可信边界: 六部分；password check 与两个数据库查询承担主要保证
technical_details_zh.可用性: 研究说明；本轮未核实独立 PDD Kit 产物

events.next_action_zh: 等公开 PDD Kit 产物和跨项目结果后，再用真实权限逻辑评估 spec 错误与可信边界。
events.next_action_en: Wait for a public PDD Kit artifact and cross-project results, then test specification errors and trusted boundaries on real authorization logic.

events.evidence_claim_en: Microsoft Research published one Rust full-stack case, the proof workflow, its trusted boundary and the limitation that a wrong specification can still verify.
events.verification: verified research report; no public standalone artifact or independent reproduction
